execution.description: Traced how a validator learns to rebuild a construction, for the owner's question.

expected: The climb procedure says how a new level reaches the validators.
observed: Miners send a declarative recipe plus the contract digest it was written against; the validator rebuilds with the reconstruction pinned in its own Carbon version and refuses a digest it does not serve. The climb procedure did not say validators must serve the new contract before miners use a level.
keep: The digest check: a level the validators do not serve is refused by name.
change: The climb procedure's last step opens a level to miners only after a person locks it and validators serve its contract.
